title: Optimize Water Distribution in a Village
summary: Given a village with n houses, determine the least cost to supply water by either building a well in each house or connecting houses with pipes, where the cost to build a well in house i is wells[i-1] and the cost to connect two houses is given in the pipes array.
statement: Given a village with n houses, determine the least cost to supply water by either building a well in each house or connecting houses with pipes, where the cost to build a well in house i is wells[i-1] and the cost to connect two houses is given in the pipes array.
constraints: Each house may connect directly to a virtual source at its well cost.
hints: Model building a well as an edge from virtual node zero to that house.
Combine virtual well edges with pipe edges.
Run Kruskal’s algorithm with union-find over nodes zero through n.
Every valid supply plan is a spanning tree of this augmented graph, so its MST is the minimum cost.
